lessons.founderObservation: Proper Title Case still missing on white card headings — screenshot showed 'Global soft-collection scale', 'Conversion-weighted growth', 'Curio since 2014'. Prior contracts/tests did not catch bypass paths.
lessons.correctExpectedBehavior: One reusable editorial Title Case utility for semantic heading fields. Apply automatically to every white card/section heading on the RIGHT cumulative proposed profile. Preserve acronyms (F&B, OTA, GDS, KPI), trademarks, brand spellings, hyphenation, numbers/dates. Never Title-Case body paragraphs. LEFT current saved profile remains unchanged. Highlight Changes marks capitalization deltas as modified. CSS text-transform is not the source of correctness. Unit tests alone are insufficient — browser-verify rendered headings.
lessons.supersededRule: Contract-only Title Case claims without proposed-profile enforcer; unit-only green without rendered heading audit

lessons.founderObservation: White section/subsection/card titles inconsistently used Proper Title Case with standalone word 'And' (e.g. 'Commercial Platform And Lobby Experience') instead of the universal ampersand convention already correct on titles like 'Independent & Soft-Brand Conversion'.
lessons.correctExpectedBehavior: Extend BE_EDITORIAL_TITLE_CASE_V1 only — do not create a second formatter. Convert spaced And/and/AND conjunctions to ' & ' in customer-facing white headings and card titles. Preserve Title Case, official brand names, trademarks, hyphenation, acronyms (including compact F&B). Never rewrite body paragraphs, bullets, citations, URLs, or internal identifiers. Compare Studio LEFT preserves CURRENT storage exactly; RIGHT applies the correction. Highlight Changes marks the heading conjunction delta as Modified (and/& identity-normalized), not unrelated remove+add. Enforce automatically for every future brand.
lessons.supersededRule: Allowing Title-Cased standalone word And in white headings; treating And vs & as unrelated card identities in Highlight Changes

Require verified operating-hotel photos or clearly labeled official renderings; otherwise show explicit research-required state. Captions must identify hotel + what is shown (e.g. 'Royal Palm Galápagos | Hotel & Guest Villas'). Compare Studio LEFT preserves the current saved image; RIGHT shows the corrected verified image; Highlight Changes marks the replacement. Retain research citations in body text.

lessons.founderObservation: Brand Explorer improvements refined in Comparison Studio must not remain isolated in the BE preview worktree. The canonical local Dealality application must render the exact approved candidate with full content, presentation, and functional parity before any Airtable writeback or publication promotion. HTTP 200, matching Git commits, or unit-test PASS alone are not proof.
lessons.correctExpectedBehavior: BE_LOCAL_PRODUCT_PARITY_GATE must PASS for the exact approved immutable candidate hash on the intended application commit before production writeback or customer promotion. Compare all ten tabs, subsections, cards, tables, bullets, images, KPIs, navigation, footprint toggles, and matching-viewport screenshots between preview and canonical local app. Fail closed on missing tabs, lost content, unexpected component diffs, style regressions, navigation failures, outdated/mismatched assets, payload version mismatch, unreconciled HPC/Airtable divergence, or stale/wrong-hash parity reports. Retain evidence in the publication audit store. Preserve Gate 1/2, scorecard, research quality, and founder approval fail-closed rules — never bypass via a separate pathway.
lessons.supersededRule: Treating BE worktree/Comparison Studio preview parity as optional or assuming merge/commit equality proves runtime product parity
